title: Mobile Application Testing Foundation
goal: Add an Android-first, evidence-backed mobile application testing slice aligned to OWASP MASVS and MASTG so AegisPT can honestly expand beyond web/API-only coverage.
scope: Implement the first mobile slice as Android-first. Support authorized APK artifact intake, static package analysis, manifest/permission review, insecure storage and transport configuration review, embedded secret/config discovery, certificate/network security config review, and optional proxy-aware dynamic preparation metadata where available. Normalize findings with MASVS/MASTG references where the mapping is clear. Keep device rooting, reverse-engineering-heavy exploit work, emulator orchestration, iOS coverage, and malware analysis out of scope for this first slice.
generation_reason: The audit found no first-class mobile assessment path in the repo, while OWASP MAS/MASTG clearly treats mobile testing as its own security testing discipline. Without a mobile slice, AegisPT cannot honestly claim broad pentest product coverage.

constraints.active_task_gate: Do not implement this task until it is the single active task in NEXT_TASK.md.
constraints.scope_creep_guard: Android-first, evidence-backed mobile testing only. No iOS support, no emulator farms, no rooting, and no destructive mobile exploit behavior in this slice.
notes: Keep mobile artifacts tenant-scoped and evidence-backed.
Do not imply complete mobile reverse engineering coverage from the first slice.
Canonical finding schema fields must remain unchanged.

success_criteria: An Android-first mobile assessment path exists for authorized APK artifacts.
Static findings cover manifest, permissions, storage, network, embedded-config, and selected secret exposure classes.
Findings can include clear MASVS/MASTG references where the mapping is explicit.
Unsupported or missing dynamic-analysis prerequisites are surfaced honestly.
Tests cover APK intake, unsupported artifact types, missing artifacts, and evidence-backed finding extraction.
No iOS, emulator, or destructive mobile claims are implied by the implementation.
must_not_touch: pack registry, validation, approval, deployment, or runtime binding flows

acceptance_criteria: Android artifact path exists and is evidence-backed.
Unsupported mobile states are surfaced honestly.
No out-of-scope mobile overclaim is introduced.

before_promotion: The prior active task is completed and logged.
Mobile artifact handling and unsupported-state language are documented.
after_completion: Update DONE_LOG.md with mobile testing implementation and validation evidence.
Update CURRENT_STATE.md with the mobile assessment baseline and remaining mobile limits.
Promote exactly one next approved task package into NEXT_TASK.md, or set an explicit holding state if the queue is exhausted.
